meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会部署一个只读网页仪表盘（默认 127.0.0.1:4690）：从 `ncl` 等 CLI 的 JSON 输出动态生成标签页和表格，并展示智能体总览、消息活动、日志尾部和只读文件查看器。
howto.when: 当你说“给 NanoClaw 加一个 clidash 只读仪表盘”，或要求把 CLI 列出的资源变成网页界面时，Claude 会执行安装。

say.text: 帮我装上 clidash 只读仪表盘。
用 ncl 的 groups、sessions 生成仪表盘标签页。
say.note: Claude 会按这些资源建表，并可加总览卡片。

say.text: 启动后检查 http://127.0.0.1:4690 是否正常。
say.note: Claude 会用 curl 验证接口并打开页面。

howto.what_en: A read-only dashboard appears at 127.0.0.1:4690. It turns JSON resource lists from CLIs (e.g. `ncl`) into tabs/tables at runtime, plus agent overview, activity charts, log tail, and read-only file viewer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to install clidash or give NanoClaw a read-only web UI driven by CLI-listed resources. Claude then copies files, creates config, tests, and starts the server.

say_en.text: Install the clidash read-only dashboard for me.
say_en.note: Claude copies files, creates config, and starts it on 127.0.0.1:4690.

say_en.text: Build dashboard tabs from ncl groups and sessions.
say_en.note: Claude creates those resource tables and can add overview cards.
Claude verifies the API and opens the page.
